items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: I played with Buddy on his last, when he was down, on his last go around. And I played with him several jobs, you know, and he played second trumpet.

ctx.x: I'd like to ask you first of all is how you started playing around what time that was and with what band you first started playing about 23

started out following Chris Kelly's band, Wooden Jewels, Lions Band, Cuckoo, Buddy Petit, points of, I was a kid, but actually I mean played with during that time like followed Chris Kelly, set and played with him, Wooden Jewels,
and René and the kids was going set and played. In 23, how old were you then?
